sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: Republicans have found themselves unexpectedly scrambling to hold on to a House seat in Tuesday's special election in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 共和党人发现自己竟然在周二俄亥俄州的特别选举中，为了保住一个众议院席位而手忙脚乱。

sentences.en: It's turned out to be a symbol of what's ahead for the party in the midterMs. It's Tuesday, August 7th.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这成为了该党中期选举前景的一个缩影。今天是8月7日，星期二。

sentences.en: Alex Burns, tell us about this election in
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯，请跟我们讲讲今天这场俄亥俄州的

sentences.en: Ohio today.
sentences.zh: 选举。

sentences.en: This is sort of an accidentally important election.
sentences.zh: 这算是一场意外变得重要的选举。

sentences.en: We're only having this vote in Ohio today because the previous Congressman Pat Tiberi, long-serving Republican, quit in the
sentences.zh: 我们今天在俄亥俄州进行这场投票，仅仅是因为前国会议员、长期任职的共和党人帕特·蒂贝里在

sentences.en: middle of his term to go take a lucrative job in the private sector.
sentences.zh: 任期中途辞职，去私营部门谋求了一份高薪工作。

sentences.en: This wasn't supposed to be a competitive race.
sentences.zh: 这本不该是一场竞争激烈的选战。

sentences.en: It's a solidly conservative district to the north and east of Columbus, Ohio, voted for President Trump by 11 percentage points and voted for other Republicans by a great deal
sentences.zh: 这是一个位于俄亥俄州哥伦布市北部和东部的稳固保守派选区，特朗普总统在这里以11个百分点的优势获胜，而其他共和党人获得的选票则

sentences.en: more than that.
sentences.zh: 更多。

sentences.en: But the race has gotten shockingly competitive and in a way that is pretty revealing for the larger landscape of the midterm election.
sentences.zh: 但这场选战变得出人意料地激烈，这在很大程度上揭示了中期选举的整体格局。

sentences.en: And you have this battle waged between two candidates who are themselves very conventional politicians.
sentences.zh: 这场角逐是在两位本身非常传统的政客之间进行的。

sentences.en: You don't have a rock star on either side of the race here.
sentences.zh: 双方都没有什么明星级人物。

sentences.en: The Republicans, a state senator named Troy Balderson, former car dealer.
sentences.zh: 共和党候选人是州参议员特洛伊·鲍尔德森，他曾是一名汽车经销商。

sentences.en: The Democrats, a 31-year-old county official, Danny O'Connor.
sentences.zh: 民主党候选人是31岁的县官员丹尼·奥康纳。

sentences.en: They are basically generic Republican, generic Democrat.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上就是典型的共和党人和典型的民主党人。

sentences.en: And so in spite of the fact that they are both basically boring candidates and despite the fact that the district is basically a conventionally Republican district, it's a very,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们两人基本上都是乏味的候选人，而且该选区基本上是一个传统的共和党选区，但这场选举却非常、

sentences.en: very close election.
sentences.zh: 非常接近。

sentences.en: And this is all about the enthusiasm on the Democratic side, the divisions within the Republican Party, the sense of basically being demoralized that you hear and see from so many
sentences.zh: 这一切都与民主党阵营的积极性、共和党内部的分歧，以及你从许多

sentences.en: conventional Republican voters.
sentences.zh: 传统共和党选民那里听到和看到的士气低落感有关。

sentences.en: So it sounds like we've got an interesting race here because it's a
sentences.zh: 所以听起来我们这里有一场有趣的选战，因为这是一个

sentences.en: Republican district that could flip to Democratic control with two kind of plain vanilla candidates that stand in for their parties more broadly.
sentences.zh: 共和党选区，却可能倒向民主党，而两位候选人都是那种平淡无奇、代表各自党派广泛立场的政客。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Plain vanilla is a much nicer thing to say about them than boring.
sentences.zh: 用“平淡无奇”来形容他们比说“乏味”要好听得多。

sentences.en: And in some ways, it's more accurate.
sentences.zh: 而且在某些方面，这更准确。

sentences.en: You don't have a larger than life figure in this race and you don't really have a larger than life issue in this race.
sentences.zh: 这场选战中没有那种超凡脱俗的人物，也没有什么惊天动地的问题。

sentences.en: You get to see really a snapshot of what the Republican message is going to be and what the Democratic message is going to be and who that message resonates with.
sentences.zh: 你真正看到的是共和党和民主党各自的竞选信息，以及这些信息能引起谁的共鸣。

sentences.en: So it's very much a race about the two parties and their strategies.
sentences.zh: 所以这在很大程度上是一场关于两党及其策略的较量。

sentences.en: Just a few months before the general election kind of feels like it's a perfect petri dish version of what November's midterms will look like.
sentences.zh: 在距离大选仅剩几个月的时候，这感觉就像是11月中期选举的一个完美实验样本。

sentences.en: It's pretty close to an ideal teSt.
sentences.zh: 这非常接近于一次理想的测试。

sentences.en: If you wanted to test the mood and the messages in this campaign nationally, you would want to do it
sentences.zh: 如果你想在全国范围内测试竞选的情绪和信息，你会希望在

sentences.en: in a district that was a little more moderate, a little more diverse than this one.
sentences.zh: 一个比这个选区更温和、更多元化一点的地方进行。

sentences.en: It's overwhelmingly white and solidly conservative.
sentences.zh: 这里绝大多数是白人，而且立场非常保守。

sentences.en: But still, this is as close to a good test as we're going to get before the final stretch in these next three months.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，这仍是我们未来三个月最后冲刺前能得到的最接近理想的测试了。

sentences.en: Does the fact that this district is very white and pretty conservative mean it's even more important to Republicans given their constituencies?
sentences.zh: 考虑到共和党的选民基础，这个选区以白人为主且非常保守，这是否意味着它对共和党人来说更加重要？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It means that this race approximates the Republican Party better than it approximates the country.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这场选战比全国情况更能代表共和党。

sentences.en: And it will tell us more about the state of the Republican coalition in the midterm elections
sentences.zh: 它告诉我们的关于中期选举中共和党联盟状况的信息，

sentences.en: and the effectiveness of the Republican message than it tells us about the mood of the country as a whole.
sentences.zh: 以及共和党竞选信息的有效性，要比它告诉我们全国整体情绪的信息多得多。

sentences.en: So how are we seeing the Republicans approach this special election?
sentences.zh: 那么我们看到共和党人是如何应对这场特别选举的呢？

sentences.en: How are they campaigning?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何进行竞选活动的？

sentences.en: Well, at the very beginning, Republicans thought that if they nominated a mainstream conservative...
sentences.zh: 嗯，起初，共和党人认为如果他们提名一位主流保守派……

sentences.en: If you want something done, call Troy Balderson, a conservative champion.
sentences.zh: 如果你想把事情做好，就找特洛伊·鲍尔德森，一位保守派的捍卫者。

sentences.en: Troy Balderson's bold leadership helped eliminate Ohio's staggering deficit...
sentences.zh: 特洛伊·鲍尔德森的大胆领导帮助消除了俄亥俄州惊人的赤字……

sentences.en: And ran on a message about taxes and the tax cut bill that made its way through Congress.
sentences.zh: 并围绕税收和国会通过的减税法案展开了竞选宣传。

sentences.en: That would just be enough in a district like this one.
sentences.zh: 在这样的选区，这应该就足够了。

sentences.en: As state senator, Troy Balderson voted to cut taxes by $5 billion.
sentences.zh: 作为州参议员，特洛伊·鲍尔德森投票支持减税50亿美元。

sentences.en: The result...
sentences.zh: 结果是……

sentences.en: In other words, look what we've done.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，看看我们做了什么。

sentences.en: We've done a good job.
sentences.zh: 我们干得不错。

sentences.en: We've got a good candidate.
sentences.zh: 我们有一位优秀的候选人。

sentences.en: Keep us in power.
sentences.zh: 让我们继续掌权。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And they thought that that message would resonate with the kind of moderately conservative suburban voter that sent Pat T.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这一信息会引起那些温和保守派郊区选民的共鸣，正是这些选民一次又一次地把帕特·蒂贝里送进国会。

sentences.en: Berry back to Congress over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文为Pat T. Berry，应为Pat Tiberi之误，译文按语境修正）

sentences.en: The National Republican Party worked actively to get Troy Balderson through the primary.
sentences.zh: 全国共和党积极运作，帮助特洛伊·鲍尔德森通过了初选。

sentences.en: He beat back a candidate who was much further to the right because they banked on, you know, mainstream conservative message.
sentences.zh: 他击败了一位立场更偏右的候选人，因为他们押注的是主流保守派的信息。

sentences.en: This shouldn't be complicated.
sentences.zh: 这本不该这么复杂。

sentences.en: Troy Balderson, an Ironman athlete.
sentences.zh: 特洛伊·鲍尔德森，一位铁人三项运动员。

sentences.en: He has grit, conservative grit.
sentences.zh: 他有毅力，保守派的毅力。

sentences.en: The kind Senator Balderson used to eliminate Ohio's budget deficit without raising taxes.
sentences.zh: 鲍尔德森参议员正是用这种毅力在不加税的情况下消除了俄亥俄州的预算赤字。

sentences.en: They ran some ads about the tax bill.
sentences.zh: 他们投放了一些关于税收法案的广告。

sentences.en: They ran some ads about Troy Balderson being, you know, good neighbor, good family man.
sentences.zh: 他们投放了一些关于特洛伊·鲍尔德森是个好邻居、好家人的广告。

sentences.en: He knows about hard work.
sentences.zh: 他懂得努力工作。

sentences.en: Balderson worked the family farm and ran the family business.
sentences.zh: 鲍尔德森在家庭农场工作，并经营着家族企业。

sentences.en: And Troy Balderson knows about walls.
sentences.zh: 特洛伊·鲍尔德森也了解围墙的重要性。

sentences.en: He'll build Trump's wall and defend Christian values.
sentences.zh: 他会修建特朗普的围墙，并捍卫基督教价值观。

sentences.en: But it just didn't get the job done.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有奏效。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the same old politics in Washington just aren't working.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，华盛顿那一套老掉牙的政治手段根本行不通。

sentences.en: Danny O'Connor, the Democrat, has run a very hard charging campaign.
sentences.zh: 民主党人丹尼·奥康纳发起了一场非常强硬的竞选活动。

sentences.en: We need new leadership in both parties.
sentences.zh: 我们需要两党都有新的领导层。

sentences.en: About shaking up Washington, about bringing new leadership to the Capitol, about protecting health care benefits and about protecting Medicare and Social Security.
sentences.zh: 关于重塑华盛顿，关于为国会带来新的领导力，关于保护医疗福利，以及保护联邦医疗保险和社会保障。

sentences.en: Let's fight back against drug and insurance company greed.
sentences.zh: 让我们反击药品和保险公司的贪婪。

sentences.en: Let's protect every dime of the Social Security and Medicare benefits seniors have earned.
sentences.zh: 让我们保护老年人应得的每一分社会保障和医疗福利。

sentences.en: I'm Danny O'Connor and I approve this message.
sentences.zh: 我是丹尼·奥康纳，我认可这条信息。

sentences.en: And so the race tightened and tightened and tightened and pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 于是选情变得越来越紧绷，而且很快。

sentences.en: Dishonest Danny O'Connor wants to take away your guns.
sentences.zh: 不诚实的丹尼·奥康纳想要夺走你们的枪支。

sentences.en: Dishonest Danny supports open borders and sanctuary cities.
sentences.zh: 不诚实的丹尼支持开放边境和庇护城市。

sentences.en: You saw national Republicans switch from a positive message about the economy to just the most relentlessly negative campaign you will find.
sentences.zh: 你看到全国共和党人从关于经济的积极信息，转向了你所能见到的最无休止的负面竞选。

sentences.en: I'll end sanctuary cities to stop illegals from taking our jobs, fight alongside Trump to implement his agenda, and use conservative grit to build the darn wall.
sentences.zh: 我将终结庇护城市，阻止非法移民抢走我们的工作，与特朗普并肩作战实施他的议程，并利用保守派的毅力去修建那该死的围墙。

sentences.en: I'm a Christian conservative who's been endorsed by Right to Life five times and have an A rating from the NRA.
sentences.zh: 我是一位基督教保守派，曾五次获得“生命权”组织的支持，并获得了美国全国步枪协会（NRA）的A级评级。

sentences.en: So Nancy Pelosi and her gang of liberals won't like me.
sentences.zh: 所以南希·佩洛西和她那帮自由派不会喜欢我。

sentences.en: I'm Republican Troy Balderson, a conservative with grit, and I approve this message.
sentences.zh: 我是共和党人特洛伊·鲍尔德森，一个有毅力的保守派，我认可这条信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And why is the strategy shift that you're describing notable from your perspective as someone who covers politics?
sentences.zh: 那么，作为一名政治报道记者，你认为这种策略的转变为何值得关注？

sentences.en: This is the kind of strategy that you normally see at the very end of a midterm election when an embattled political party feels like it has no option but to go all negative on
sentences.zh: 这通常是你在中期选举临近尾声时才会看到的策略，当时一个陷入困境的政党觉得除了对对手进行全面负面攻击外，别无选择。

sentences.en: the other side.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文为“on the other side”，即对另一方进行攻击）

sentences.en: And what you have right now is three months before the general election, the end of the
sentences.zh: 而现在，在距离大选还有三个月的时候，在全国竞选的最后阶段，共和党领导人指着这场选战和这种策略说，这就是我们保住众议院的方法。

sentences.en: national campaign, Republican Party leaders pointing at this race and this strategy and saying this is how we're going to keep the House.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，该党并没有等到即将到来的秋季中期选举的最后几周才采取这种负面策略，就像他们在俄亥俄州这个选区所做的那样。

sentences.en: In other words, the party isn't waiting until the last few weeks of the upcoming midterms this fall to go this negative as they are doing in this district in
sentences.zh: 他们将其视为剩余中期选举的策略。没错。

sentences.en: Ohio.
sentences.zh: 这不是最后的手段。

sentences.en: They're viewing it as the strategy for the rest of the midterMs. That's right.
sentences.zh: 这是他们最好的希望。

sentences.en: This is not the last resort.
sentences.zh: 这说明了什么？

sentences.en: This is their best hope.
sentences.zh: 这说明共和党人陷入了大麻烦，而且他们心知肚明。

sentences.en: And what does that tell us?
sentences.zh: 所以你去了俄亥俄州，看看这场选战的情况。

sentences.en: It tells us the Republicans are in a lot of trouble and they know it.
sentences.zh: 我去了。

sentences.en: So you went to Ohio to check out what's happening in this race.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他支持特朗普支持的东西，所以……

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, he supports what the Trump supports, so...
sentences.zh: 你对副总统总体上有什么看法？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: And what do you think of the vice president in general?
sentences.zh: 太棒了，伙计。

sentences.en: Oh, excellent.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Excellent, man.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 有什么特别的吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他是个基督徒，伙计。

sentences.en: Anything in particular?
sentences.zh: 他比我想象中更有价值观。

sentences.en: Well, he's a Christian, man.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: He's got more values than, uh, than what I think.
sentences.zh: 那民主党人呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得他们完全偏离了方向，但是……

sentences.en: And what about the Democrat?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你去的时候，距离选举还有一周，共和党候选人鲍尔德森的竞选情况如何？

sentences.en: Well, I think they're off in left field myself, but...
sentences.zh: 我去的时候，他们最大的担忧，而且我认为直到今天依然是他们的担忧，就是如何让支持他们的选民参与进来并充满热情。

sentences.en: So what's the situation there for the Republican campaign, Balderson, a week out from the election when you were there?
sentences.zh: 他们的担忧是，坦率地说，在两党的民调中，那些最关注这场选举、知道选举日期、计划去投票的选民，往往倾向于民主党。

sentences.en: When I was there, their big concern, and I think it's still their concern today, was just about getting voters on their side engaged and energized.
sentences.zh: 这个选区的共和党人比民主党人多得多，但总的来说，他们对这场选举并不那么关注。

sentences.en: That their concern is that in polling, frankly, for both political parties, the voters who are paying the most attention to this race, who know
sentences.zh: 这对鲍尔德森来说尤其是一个问题。

sentences.en: the date of the election, who are planning to show up, tend to lean towards the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这对鲍尔德森来说是个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: There are many more Republicans in this district than there are Democrats, but by and large, they're just not that focused on this race.
sentences.zh: 民主党人每天早上醒来都在寻找机会向总统传达信息，并为改变华盛顿的现状做点什么。

sentences.en: And that's a problem for especially Balderson.
sentences.zh: 这个选区的共和党人，也许有些人会出来投票向华盛顿传达信息。

sentences.en: It's a huge problem for Balderson.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，你是在要求一群相对自满的人在8月的第一个星期二出来投票。

sentences.en: Democrats wake up every morning looking for opportunities to send a message to the president and to do something about the state of things in Washington.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的这种热情差距在中期选举中很典型吗？

sentences.en: Republicans in this district, maybe some of them will show up to send a message to Washington.

sentences.en: That is greater than what the Democrats have spent by a factor of five or six.
sentences.zh: 那么今天在俄亥俄州发生的事情有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: They can't have that kind of spending advantage in every race around the country in
sentences.zh: 看，我认为大多数参与竞选的人都认为鲍尔德森更有可能以微弱优势获胜。

sentences.en: November.
sentences.zh: 这可能会给共和党人一点信心，认为这是一种可以在全国大部分地区奏效的策略。

sentences.en: They want enough money.
sentences.zh: 如果该策略失败，那么对于共和党来说，你就真的处于“紧急情况下打破玻璃”的境地了。

sentences.en: There's not enough money in the House campaign in total to put that into all the competitive races.
sentences.zh: 他们已经用尽了所有手段来试图动员他们的人。

sentences.en: A district that the president carried by 11 points should be a district that's responsive to a message about keep the progress, keep up the momentum in Washington,
sentences.zh: 如果这不起作用，目前没有后备计划。

sentences.en: reward us for the things we've done so far.
sentences.zh: 意思是如果“现代启示录”策略失败，那剩下的就只有启示录了。

sentences.en: That message didn't connect.
sentences.zh: 对于共和党来说，距离选举还有90天，却没有任何策略能保住一个总统曾以11个百分点优势获胜的选区，这确实会让他们感到恐慌。

sentences.en: So what would you call this strategy being practiced at this moment in Ohio?
sentences.zh: 如果你连总统以两位数优势获胜的选区都保不住，那你就麻烦了。

sentences.en: I think you have to see it as kind of an apocalypse now strategy, right?
sentences.zh: 这对共和党人来说是最令人担忧的。

sentences.en: That this is every piece of ordinance that Republicans have lobbed with incredible funding behind it at this basically unremarkable Democrat.
sentences.zh: 同样令共和党人担忧的是，如果他们仅以一个、两个或三个百分点的优势保住这个选区。

sentences.en: And what's the significance of what happens today in Ohio?
sentences.zh: 有几十个选区的竞争比这个选区激烈得多。

sentences.en: Look, I think most people involved in the race think that Balderson is more likely than not to win
sentences.zh: 如果这种“砍杀”策略只能以一两个百分点的优势保住这个选区，那么肯定有足够的选区让民主党人夺取众议院控制权，而这些选区的选民立场比这个选区更中间化。

sentences.en: by a little, which would give Republicans maybe a little bit of confidence that this is a strategy that can work in much of the country.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: If the strategy fails, then you are really in a break glass in case of emergency situation for the GOP.
sentences.zh: 所以，今天在俄亥俄州这场补选中共和党人的胜利，可能仍然感觉像是一场失败。

sentences.en: They've used everything they had here to try to get their people out.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，几乎没有共和党人会因为在这个选区以一个百分点的优势获胜而感到安心。

sentences.en: If it doesn't work, there's no fallback plan right now.
sentences.zh: 所以亚历克斯，这样说准确吗：在共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普于2016年凭借无休止的负面和两极分化策略获胜，并以同样的方式执政后，他的共和党众议院多数派现在需要一场无休止的负面和两极分化的中期竞选来捍卫其权力。

sentences.en: Meaning if the apocalyptic now strategy fails, then it's just the apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: That's certainly how it would feel to the Republican Party to have 90 days left until the election
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: with no strategy that can keep even a district that the president won by 11 points in their hands.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: If you can't save the district that the president won by double digits, then you're in trouble.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: That would be most alarming for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: Also alarming for Republicans is if they hang on to this district by one point, two points, three points.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: There are dozens and dozens and dozens of districts that are much more closely divided than this one.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: And if the slash and burn strategy can only save this district by a point or two, there are certainly enough districts for Democrats to take the
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: house that are well to the center of this one.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: So a win for Republicans today in this special election in Ohio could still feel like a loss.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: There are going to be very, very few Republicans in Washington reassured by a one point win in this district.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: So Alex, is it accurate to say that that after a Republican presidential candidate, Donald Trump, won on a relentlessly negative and
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: polarizing strategy in 2016 and then governed pretty much the same way, his Republican house majority
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: now requires a relentlessly negative and polarizing midterm campaign to defend its power.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: And what does that tell us?
sentences.zh: 这告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: I think that's exactly accurate.
sentences.zh: 我认为这完全准确。

sentences.en: And it makes a lot of Republicans extremely uncomfortable and nervous that this is not the campaign they envisioned a year and a half ago.
sentences.zh: 这让许多共和党人感到极其不安和紧张，因为这并不是他们一年半前所设想的竞选活动。

sentences.en: They thought they'd be able to run in the midterm elections on an upbeat forward-looking message about economic
sentences.zh: 他们原以为能以一种乐观、前瞻性的口号参加中期选举，谈论经济

sentences.en: prosperity, about having kept their promises on issues like health care and immigration and taxes and national security.
sentences.zh: 繁荣，谈论他们在医疗保健、移民、税收和国家安全等问题上信守了承诺。

sentences.en: And instead, they have this relatively demoralizing slog ahead of them of essentially having to tear down their opponents all over again.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们面前却是一场相对令人沮丧的苦战，基本上不得不再次彻底摧毁他们的对手。

sentences.en: And by the way, this time they don't have Hillary Clinton to help them.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这一次他们没有希拉里·克林顿来帮忙了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I guess what I'm wondering is, once you go that negative, are you kind of stuck campaigning that way as long as you've got that same president in power?
sentences.zh: 我想知道的是，一旦你采取了这种负面攻击的策略，只要那位总统还在位，你就只能一直这样竞选下去了吗？

sentences.en: Does that become the message of the Republican Party?
sentences.zh: 这会成为共和党的竞选口号吗？

sentences.en: There is no separating the
sentences.zh: 在选民眼中，目前已经无法将

sentences.en: Republican Party from President Trump in the eyes of voters at this point.
sentences.zh: 共和党与特朗普总统分开了。

sentences.en: We have seen that so consistently in the elections since he took office, and we're seeing it in this one too.
sentences.zh: 自他上任以来的历次选举中，我们都始终如一地看到了这一点，在这次选举中我们也看到了。

sentences.en: That's part of why Republicans have decided to take the risk of bringing in the president, bringing in the vice
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么共和党人决定冒着风险邀请总统，邀请副

sentences.en: president into a district where they are polarizing because they are making the bet that the polarization will work for them.
sentences.zh: 总统来到他们具有争议的选区，因为他们押注这种两极分化会对自己有利。

sentences.en: Thank you, Alex.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.zh: 今天凌晨1点01分，特朗普政府重新对伊朗实施了20年前的经济制裁，这些制裁曾被

sentences.en: Obama as part of the Iran nuclear deal.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统作为伊朗核协议的一部分而解除。

sentences.en: President Trump said the sanctions would encourage Iran to renegotiate the 2015 nuclear deal, which he pulled out of in May.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，这些制裁将鼓励伊朗重新谈判他在5月份退出的2015年核协议。

sentences.en: But the most immediate consequence has been to infuriate America's allies in Europe, including Britain, Germany, and France, who fear
sentences.zh: 但最直接的后果是激怒了美国在欧洲的盟友，包括英国、德国和法国，他们担心

sentences.en: the sanctions could severely punish domestic companies that do business with Iran.
sentences.zh: 这些制裁可能会严厉惩罚与伊朗有业务往来的本国公司。

sentences.en: On Monday, the three countries announced a plan to block the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一，这三个国家宣布了一项计划，旨在阻止美国

sentences.en: from punishing those businesses, as the sanctions require.
sentences.zh: 按照制裁要求惩罚这些企业。

sentences.en: And just like the Bible says, it's basically an intergalactic invasion into this space through people.
sentences.zh: 就像《圣经》里说的那样，这基本上是一场通过人类进入这个空间的星际入侵。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, it's what all the ancients said.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你们，这就是所有古人所说的。

sentences.en: After a lengthy debate about free speech, censorship, and fake news, four major platforms—YouTube, Spotify, Apple, and Facebook—have removed content from Alex Jones,
sentences.zh: 在关于言论自由、审查制度和假新闻的长时间辩论后，四大平台——YouTube、Spotify、苹果和Facebook——已经删除了亚历克斯·琼斯的内容，

sentences.en: the right-wing conspiracy theorist whose site has falsely claimed, among other things,
sentences.zh: 这位右翼阴谋论者的网站曾虚假声称，除其他事项外，

sentences.en: that high-ranking Democrats are pedophiles, and that the Sandy Hook Elementary School massacre was a hoax.
sentences.zh: 高级民主党人是恋童癖，桑迪胡克小学大屠杀是一场骗局。

sentences.en: They're demons.
sentences.zh: 他们是恶魔。

sentences.en: They're frickin' interdimensional invaders, okay?
sentences.zh: 他们是该死的跨维度入侵者，好吗？

sentences.en: I'll just say it, make fun of me all you want, on CNN or wherever, but everyone already innately knows this.
sentences.zh: 我只想说出来，你们可以在CNN或任何地方尽情嘲笑我，但每个人内心深处都已经知道这一点。

sentences.en: These people are not frickin' humans, okay?
sentences.zh: 这些人根本不是该死的人类，好吗？

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton is a goddamn demon!
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿是个该死的恶魔！

sentences.en: Each company said that Jones' work had violated their policies.
sentences.zh: 每家公司都表示，琼斯的作品违反了他们的政策。

sentences.en: Apple does not tolerate hate speech, the company wrote in a statement.
sentences.zh: 苹果公司在一份声明中写道，苹果不容忍仇恨言论。

sentences.en: In a message of his own on Twitter, Jones called the removals an attack on his politics, asking, quote, what conservative outlet will be next?
sentences.zh: 琼斯在Twitter上发布了自己的消息，称这些删除是对他政治立场的攻击，并问道：“下一个会是哪个保守派媒体？”
